answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using trust-graph routing. Nodes verify peers by tracing random walks across interaction edges to intersect certified paths from trusted seeds. This forces an attacker to expend scarce topological trust capital across network cuts. While an adversary can flash an ephemeral comet of fake nodes, none can cross the bottleneck to reach the consensus summit. However, an honest sparrow node without prior edges suffers high onboarding latency.
